non_triggered_relevant_signals.interpretation: One composite macro gate replaces separate drawdown, recovery, and volatility alerts. It requires Phase 1 early recovery and high realized volatility to be true together.
non_triggered_relevant_signals.name: high_volatility_recovery

non_triggered_relevant_signals.interpretation: Positive and unusually high short-underlying minus long beta indicates that a market rebound can squeeze the recent-loser leg. Threshold: prior-only 80th percentile from 2302 observations; raw historical threshold=0.247218.
non_triggered_relevant_signals.name: short_minus_long_beta_gap

non_triggered_relevant_signals.interpretation: Long-short wealth relative to its highest level in the prior 63 trading days is compared with its own prior-only left-tail history. The threshold can never be looser than -20%, and drawdowns shallower than 5% are not material. Threshold: prior-only 20th percentile from 2302 observations; raw historical threshold=-0.17199.
non_triggered_relevant_signals.name: portfolio_drawdown

non_triggered_relevant_signals.interpretation: Trailing 21-day short loss magnitude is the sum of negative signed short contributions. It triggers only when Phase 1 early recovery is active and the loss reaches the threshold. Threshold: prior-only 80th percentile from 2344 observations; raw historical threshold=0.249399.
non_triggered_relevant_signals.name: short_loss_in_recovery
